stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: Premiership points to Kade Macdonald with 23 pts, and the percentage is looking very healthy.

stories.title: Family Affair
stories.detail: Brendan and Tom have turned the card in for the Shumack household, and nobody is conceding anything.

stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: Climbed 14 places - the mover of the day

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Ben Brown of Queanbeyan GC is welcome back anytime, preferably off a few less shots.

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 4 twos in a row on holes 15-18 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: On Cruise Control
stories.detail: A run of 6 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 9 & 10

stories.title: On the Charge
stories.detail: Back-to-back 3-pointers on holes 7 & 8

stories.title: Rock Solid
stories.detail: Zero wipes and 6 two-pointers - boring in the best way

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: One Step Forward...
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 15, 1-pointer on hole 16

stories.title: Two's Company
stories.detail: 3-pointers on holes 13 & 14 - this is momentum

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 4 twos on holes 14-18 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 3, 4 & 5

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Vanilla Golf
stories.detail: 6 straight two-pointers on holes 9-14

stories.title: Points: Not Found
stories.detail: 3 wipes, zero 3-pointers from 9 holes - the course hides its rewards well

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.title: The Phoenix
stories.detail: Wipe then 3-pointer on holes 13 & 14 - drama then redemption

stories.title: The Bounce Back
stories.detail: Wipe then a 3-pointer on holes 12 & 13

stories.title: Rough Patch
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 15 & 16 - club still in the bag

stories.title: The Course Wins Again
stories.detail: 3 straight on holes 10, 11 & 12 - the handicap card stays in the bag

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: A gentle slide for Scott McLachlan, 1st to 9th, nothing a decent pre-season will not fix.

stories.title: In the Wet
stories.detail: The rain gauge tipped 11.6 and the field simply put the head down and kept going.
